tasks.gr8-scramble-for-africa-t3: Topic: The Scramble for Africa. Cover the Berlin Conference, colonisation, Ashanti kingdom, British imperialism, African resistance, and historical consequences. Ask Grade 8 learners to interpret sources and perspectives, order key events, and explain clear historical causes and outcomes.
tasks.gr8-ashanti-kingdom-and-the-gold-coast-t: Topic: Case study of the Ashanti kingdom. Cover the coast of West Africa before the Europeans, the Ashanti and their early contact with European traders, the British and the colonisation of the Gold Coast, and the results for the Ashanti kingdom and for Britain. Ask Grade 8 learners to read short sources from British and Ashanti points of view, compare them, and explain cause and effect. Keep contested numbers out of questions.
